column1: # 32 px studies for Plants' tropical proposal sheet (directions A Real Amazon, B Lush jungle, C Giant canopy). STUDIES ONLY: never installed.
# BLOCK_LIKE: s_twoblock tall_grass_lower,tall_grass_upper,heliconia; s_bigleaf leaves_brazil_nut,leaves_cacao; s_floor moss_block_top,leaf_litter_top,liana; s_flowers heliconia,lupine,liana

column3: study_banana_top|plant|TOP HALF of a two-block wild banana plant: 3-4 huge paddle leaves 10-14 px wide arching out and drooping from stalks that continue up from the bottom edge (they continue the bottom half below at the same columns), bright mid green (#2e5a26 #427a32 #5e9a44 #7cb458) with a pale midrib and a few torn slits along the edges, filling the upper half
column4: study_philodendron_top|plant|TOP HALF of a two-block giant Philodendron: 3 huge heart-shaped glossy leaves 12-16 px wide, dark green (#1e3e1c #2c5428 #3e6e36 #5a8c4a) with pale veins, on long stalks that continue up from the bottom edge (the same columns as the half below), leaves tilted outward
column5: study_banana_bottom|plant|BOTTOM HALF of the same two-block wild banana: a thick green pseudo-stem 4-5 px wide (#4e6a30 #64843c #7a9a48) rising from the bottom edge to the TOP edge, wrapped in older brown-edged leaf sheaths, with one lower leaf arching out to the side
column6: study_philodendron_bottom|plant|BOTTOM HALF of the same two-block giant Philodendron: a cluster of long green leaf stalks (#3e6e36 #5a8c4a) rising from the bottom edge to the TOP edge, with two lower heart-shaped dark green leaves (#2c5428 #3e6e36) and a few aerial roots

column3: study_bigleaf_1|leaves|Big-leaf tropical canopy leaves, variant 1: only 4 large leathery oblong leaves 10-12 px long, glossy green (#24401c #34582a #487236 #5e8a44 #76a256) with pale midribs and highlights, overlapping at different angles, magenta gaps 20-30%
column4: study_bigleaf_2|leaves|The same big-leaf canopy leaves, variant 2: 4-5 large oblong leaves 10-12 px long at different angles and places from variant 1, same colours, magenta gaps 20-30%
column5: study_bigleaf_3|leaves|The same big-leaf canopy leaves, variant 3: 3-4 large leaves 10-12 px long plus one young drooping leaf, different places from variants 1 and 2, same colours, magenta gaps 20-30%
column6: study_bigleaf_4|leaves|The same big-leaf canopy leaves, variant 4: 5 large leaves 9-11 px long in a fan, different places, same colours, magenta gaps 20-30%

column3: study_vine_hanging|plant|A hanging jungle vine curtain for one block: 3 thin green vine strands 2 px wide (#2e5a26 #427a32 #5e9a44) hanging from the top edge to the bottom edge at fixed columns (stacked tiles join), with small round and heart-shaped leaves along them, some strands ending in curled tips
column4: study_vine_wall|cutout|Vines growing flat on a tree trunk, seen face-on: a net of green vines 2 px wide with many small heart-shaped leaves (#2e5a26 #427a32 #5e9a44 #7cb458) covering about half the square, the rest magenta (the bark shows through), vines reaching all four edges so they join
column5: study_moss_carpet|cube|Thick tropical moss carpet seen from above: soft cushion-like clumps of bright and deep green moss (#2e4a1e #3e6428 #557e34 #6e9a42 #8ab454), small round domes, a few tiny fern sprouts, fills the whole square
column6: study_leaf_litter_deep|cube|Deep rainforest leaf litter seen from above: a thick layer of fallen broad leaves 6-10 px long, brown, tan and dark red-brown (#3e2a1c #5a3e26 #7a5634 #9a7448 #b89462), a few yellow and green fresher leaves, fills the whole square

column3: study_passionflower|plant|A passionflower vine: a twisting green vine 2 px wide with three-lobed leaves (#2e5a26 #427a32) and two open passionflowers 7-8 px across, white-lilac petals (#e8e0f4 #c8b8e4) with a fringed purple-and-white corona (#6a3a8a #9a5ab4) and a green-yellow centre, about 26 px tall
column4: study_bromeliad|plant|A bromeliad sitting on a horizontal branch: a rosette of stiff strap-shaped leaves 3 px wide, green with red tips (#3e6a2c #5a8a3e #a8302a), fanning out from a centre, and a bright red-pink flower spike (#c8283a #e85068) in the middle; at the bottom a short grey-brown branch stub it sits on, about 18 px tall
column5: study_orchid|plant|An epiphytic orchid on a branch: a few thick strap leaves (#3e6a2c #5a8a3e) and an arching spray of 4 small flowers, magenta-pink with pale centres (#d03a8a #e870b0 #f8d0e4), about 20 px tall
column6: study_heliconia_hanging|plant|A hanging heliconia: a big paddle-leaf clump at the bottom (#2e5a26 #427a32 #5e9a44) and a long pendulous flower spike hanging down from an arch, zig-zag stacked bracts bright red with yellow-green tips (#b0202a #e0402e #f2c83a #9ac040), about 28 px tall
